description: This file defines the OrderStatus controller class within the OpenCart admin localization namespace. It manages CRUD operations and listing for order statuses, including rendering forms, processing form submissions, and generating paginated lists.

classes.name: OrderStatus
classes.description: Controller class for managing order statuses in the OpenCart admin panel, including listing, form handling, saving, deleting, and listing order status entries.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the main listing page for order statuses, including sorting, pagination, and rendering the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of order statuses as a JSON response.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the paginated list of order statuses based on sorting and filtering parameters.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing an order status.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the saving of a new or existing order status, returning a JSON response with success or error message.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected order statuses and responds with JSON status.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected order statuses and responds with JSON status. The method involves loading language files, verifying permissions, extracting selected IDs from POST data, deleting corresponding order statuses via the model, and returning success/error messages in JSON format.
